'''Ki-Ve''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] mystic who foresaw [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Torius]]' plan to detonate a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] at [[Voss-Ka]]. The Voss knew that he would be stopped by [[Havoc Squad]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] and did not interfere until the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was [[Death/Legends|dead]], after which they revealed all they knew and asked the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to give them the bomb for study.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />
